comments.author: CafeinSquirrel
comments.body_html:
I saw what you did there! Love you, man. You have no idea how much time that saved me. Before this, I had to configure every single map and bot files just to stop them from shooting me, and the only way I could freeze the bots was by abusing a bug involving the Pause mod and the AI Limit mod.

Hopefully, in the future, someone will make a mod that lets you configure bot hostility directly. Setting up an NPC battle wouldn’t have to take 4–5 hours anymore.

Edit: I’m not sure if you already know this, but some bots have separate follower types, such as normal bosses with their guards or the Goons. If you spawn them individually, their followers don’t recognize their leader as an ally or boss they treat them as neutral bots instead. As a result, they can friendly-fire each other and won’t use SAIN’s squad features properly. Other bot types, such as regular PMC and Scav groups, Raiders, and Rogues you can spawn as many as you want AT THE SAME TIME, and the game automatically assigns the first bot that spawns as the squad leader.
